Two implementations exist because the partitions tab filters and sorts on the

A null stored value is NOT in this table: it is the one deliberate divergence
(the server returns null so the listing can sort and filter it; the browser
renders the literal 'null' because a cell must show something), and each side
pins it in its own test.

vectors.why: floors below the epoch; naive arithmetic gives 1970--1
the calendar year, not an offset
a bucket INDEX; rendered bare, 3 reads as data
a transform a newer writer added: the stored value is the best answer
a malformed ordinal must not become a confident wrong date
past Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER: refused on both sides so they agree on which inputs decode

AT the safe-integer bound: representable as a JS number and NOT as an instant. Both sides must degrade to the stored string; the browser used to throw RangeError out of new Date(...).toISOString(), which took the files tab's render down.
